source_quality.notes: the production function, the shadow price, the recovery recurrence and the green product were read from the raster; the text layer drops the subscripts

task_reconstruction: Price the ecosystem cost of a land use project in three parts, carry the pollution forward with a recovery model, and compare the cost-benefit ratio with and without that cost.

section_map.summary: the three parts and the reversed verdict
the tax and the green product

contributions.summary: a production function with the net primary production as a factor
a recovery recurrence with a cutoff at half the critical value
a ratio with the ecosystem cost added below
a green product built from the resource consumption

dependency_graph.relation: the production is the added factor
the shadow price enters the ecosystem cost
the pollution cost enters the ecosystem cost
the degradation is what the recovery spreads over the years
the recovered stock sets the yearly degradation cost

assumptions.summary: the net cash flow is the same every year
the discount rate is three percent
all capital and labor come from natural resources

data_and_preprocessing.summary: the constants of the ecological value are tabulated
the weights are trained on twenty projects
the three projects are itemized in an appendix sheet

verification.summary: a one percent noise added to the inputs

results_trace.summary: the house flips from worth building to not
the steel mill stays worth building either way
the largest change under the noise is 0.56 percent

writing_logic.summary: the background closes on a necessity
the curve is split at a turning point
the tax is defined as an equalization

language_observations.summary: opens by cutting the cost into three named parts
justifies the new form by what the old one cannot show
gives each ratio its verdict in the same sentence
owns the missing factors and the unrepresentative case

visualization_observations.summary: the network is drawn as a hierarchy of pollutants
the degradation cost is drawn for the bridge and the steel plant
the degradation cost is drawn for the house and the subway
the stock is drawn for several values of the threshold

judge_relevance_hypotheses.summary: pairing each ratio with its verdict reads as a paper that wants the decision checked against the number
calling the chosen mill unrepresentative reads as a paper that limits its own example

weaknesses.summary: the prose names the derivative backwards
the two recovery functions are set equal to the same sum
the depreciation cites the wrong formula
inflation is left out and the mill is unrepresentative

independent_extensions.summary: split the ecosystem cost into resource consumption, pollution and degradation, and price each part on its own
carry the pollutant forward year by year and stop the purification once the stock passes a stated threshold

unresolved_questions: the prose names the derivative of the shadow price backwards
the recovery functions gamma and lambda are both tied to the same sum
the depreciation cites formula (20), which prices the land
the sum in the green product starts at the letter o
